text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: How strange... I could have sworn it was right here...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's not here after all. Now then,
where did I put that bead weaving book?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I was sure I put all the books I brought from home in the same spot, though...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if this is what they call forgetfulness...
Maybe it's because I've been pushing too hard in training.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, no! They say if you just leave things forgotten,
you'll only get more forgetful!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, I'll search until I find it!
Little lost book-chan, come out, come out wherever you are~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Wonder Acute ended up searching for her things well into the night.
